index.title: Compare the performance of different AI agents in real-world tasks
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Compare Performance. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Compare the performance of different AI agents in real-world tasks. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. Y
index.what_happened_excerpt: A comparison of AI agents, Grok Bot, Hermes, and OpenClaw, was conducted, highlighting the gap between demo and real-world performance, and noting the advantages of Grok Bot's stateful intelligence and native plugin integration.
